# The seam probe — generated by `node native/eval/harm-seam.mjs`

Deterministic; no model, no network. `native/tests/harm-seam.test.js` asserts this same run, so this file cannot drift from what is enforced.

| arm | writers' own checks | compiles | previous oracle (reads source) | rendered contracts owned | lands on compile alone | with the decomposer's contracts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| control/baseline | n/a | ok | audio FAIL, ethos FAIL | audio FAIL, ethos FAIL | n/a (not a candidate) | n/a |
| disjoint/correct | n/a | ok | audio ok, ethos ok | audio ok, ethos ok | landed | landed |
| oracle/dead-audio-keeps-link | n/a | ok | audio ok, ethos ok | audio FAIL, ethos ok | landed **(broken)** **(silent to the previous oracle)** | refused — seam_broken: audio |
| oracle/wrong-property | n/a | ok | audio FAIL, ethos ok | audio FAIL, ethos ok | landed **(broken)** | refused — seam_broken: audio |

Notes on the rows:

- **control/baseline** — the round-4 artifact as it stands (both known defects) — the starting point, not a candidate join. Rendered failures — audio: pass: no <audio> element; conflict: no <audio> element; no_signal: no <audio> element | ethos: no_signal: label "conflict" (wanted "no signal")
- **disjoint/correct** — audio + ethos in disjoint regions with correct writers — the previous run's own design.
- **oracle/dead-audio-keeps-link** — an <audio controls> with no src, beside a surviving download link. Rendered failures — audio: pass: no controlled <audio> whose src is https://cdn.example/a.mp3 (found [{"controls":true,"src":null}]); conflict: no controlled <audio> whose src is https://cdn.example/b.mp3 (found [{"controls":true,"src":null}]); no_signal: no controlled <audio> whose src is https://cdn.example/c.mp3 (found [{"controls":true,"src":null}])
- **oracle/wrong-property** — src reads episode.url, a property that does not exist (the source-level oracle SHOULD catch this). Rendered failures — audio: pass: no controlled <audio> whose src is https://cdn.example/a.mp3 (found [{"controls":true,"src":"undefined"}]); conflict: no controlled <audio> whose src is https://cdn.example/b.mp3 (found [{"controls":true,"src":"undefined"}]); no_signal: no controlled <audio> whose src is https://cdn.example/c.mp3 (found [{"controls":true,"src":"undefined"}])
- **oracle/source-child** — a legitimate <audio controls><source src></audio> form (both oracles SHOULD pass this).
- **seam/verbatim** — style + markup writers agree on the class spelling (the control: the seam holds when the conventions coincide).
- **seam/kebab** — the markup writer's house convention is kebab; the style writer targets the spelling its own fragment shows. Rendered failures — color: no_signal: renders unstyled (wanted gray; badge classes: ethos-badge no-signal)
- **seam/prefixed** — the markup writer's house convention is prefixed; the style writer targets the spelling its own fragment shows. Rendered failures — color: pass: renders unstyled (wanted green; badge classes: ethos-badge ethos-pass); conflict: renders unstyled (wanted red; badge classes: ethos-badge ethos-conflict); no_signal: renders unstyled (wanted gray; badge classes: ethos-badge ethos-no_signal)
- **seam/bem** — the markup writer's house convention is bem; the style writer targets the spelling its own fragment shows. Rendered failures — color: pass: renders unstyled (wanted green; badge classes: ethos-badge ethos-badge--pass); conflict: renders unstyled (wanted red; badge classes: ethos-badge ethos-badge--conflict); no_signal: renders unstyled (wanted gray; badge classes: ethos-badge ethos-badge--no-signal)
- **seam/declared** — the same kebab-case markup writer, handed the declared interface (vocabulary only; no code from the other side).
